card.title: Notification Settings
card.description: Proactively notify HR/managers to review when an employee submits a leave or overtime application. Choose not to send, send an email (basic auth or OAuth2 supported), or post to a Microsoft Teams channel.

smtp.allowSelfSignedCertHint: Self-hosted mail servers often use self-signed certificates, causing sending to fail with "unable to get local issuer certificate". Enable this to skip verification. Only recommended on a trusted internal network — this reduces protection against man-in-the-middle attacks on the SMTP connection.
smtp.oauthHelp: You'll need to register an application in your mail provider's admin console (e.g. Microsoft Entra ID, Google Cloud Console) to obtain a refresh token first. This is a one-time setup — this system does not provide an OAuth authorization page.

teams.webhookHelp: Set up an "Incoming Webhook" connector on the target channel to get the URL. If your organization uses the newer Power Automate workflow webhook instead, the format may not be compatible.

branding.title: Browser tab icon and title
branding.description: Customize the small icon (favicon) and title shown on the browser tab. Everyone, including the login page, will see them.
branding.hint: PNG, ICO, SVG, JPG and WEBP are supported, up to {{kb}} KB. A square image (PNG at 64×64 or larger, or SVG) works best. Others see the change after refreshing; browsers sometimes cache the old icon, so try a hard refresh if needed.
branding.titlePlaceholder: Leave blank for the default title
branding.titleHint: Up to 50 characters. Save with the field empty to restore the default title.
